result.summary: Found 3 issues related to layout and content truncation in a food delivery app interface.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' horizontal carousel cuts off the third item ('Trattoria Piccol...') abruptly at the right edge, showing partial text and a clipped card without clear visual indication that it's scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add a visible scroll indicator, gradient fade, or peek-effect that clearly signals more content is available, and ensure restaurant names have room to display or use ellipsis intentionally.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' is truncated mid-word without an ellipsis, making it unclear whether the truncation is intentional or a rendering error.
issues.suggestion: Apply proper text-overflow ellipsis styling so truncated names end with '...' for clarity.

issues.description: The bottom pizza card in 'Popular right now' section is cut off at the bottom of the viewport, showing only a partial image and no restaurant details, which may look broken rather than scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Ensure adequate spacing above the bottom navigation bar and consider adding visual cues that content continues below the fold.
